# `replace`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
replace(str, search[, replace])
```

Replaces all occurrences of `search` with `replace`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [2, 3] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- replace, example 1
> SELECT replace('ABCabc', 'abc', 'DEF');
ABCDEF
```
